# TradesFlow

> Field-service operations prototype for asset-heavy trades — equipment, service notes, deficiencies, billing.

## What it is
A Next.js prototype for field-service operators: equipment records, service notes, deficiencies, scheduling, and billing handoffs.

## Install / use
Clone and run with npm; see the live demo linked in the repo.

## Links
- Repository: https://github.com/simongonzalezdc/tradesflow
